HTTP client for the Untis API
YUntis is free and open-source software licensed under the GNU GPL-3.0.
YUntis is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with Untis. It uses partially undocumented interfaces, which can change or stop working at any time.
YUntis is based on UntisX by Losterixx (codeberg.org/Losterixx/UntisX), which is heavily inspired by BetterUntis, the open-source Untis client for Android.
